caller_is_owner.meaning: the caller of increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() is the onlyOwner authority

deadline_expired.meaning: the caller-provided deadline has passed so the liquidity increase transaction can no longer be executed
deadline_expired.checkpoint: at execution attempt of the liquidity increase

transaction_executed_after_deadline.meaning: the liquidity increase transaction executes even though the caller-provided deadline has expired
transaction_executed_after_deadline.checkpoint: after the liquidity increase transaction executes

protocol_financial_loss.meaning: the protocol is exposed to significant financial losses
protocol_financial_loss.checkpoint: after the liquidity increase transaction executes

assumptions: The deadline is caller-provided and the transaction is a liquidity increase via increaseLiquidityCurrentRange().
Financial loss is described as potential; no concrete amount, token, or value is given.

unresolved.description: Report does not quantify the significant financial loss or state a concrete observed transaction; the loss is only described as potential exposure.

limitations: The financial-loss impact is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric magnitude or unit.
Whether amountMin0_/amountMin1_ slippage bounds mitigate the harm is not analyzed in the report.
